name: Element
install: npm install --prefix ../pnpm --no-save --no-audit --no-fund pnpm@11.23.0 && PATH="$(cd ../pnpm/node_modules/.bin && pwd):$PATH" pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

build.command: PATH="$(cd ../pnpm/node_modules/.bin && pwd):$PATH" NX_DAEMON=false NX_NO_CLOUD=true NX_TUI=false pnpm --dir apps/web build
